issue.title: Failed incident visual goldens show pre-NEEDS ATTENTION detail panel
issue.description:
Run the targeted visual check on a clean tree (no uncommitted changes):

  just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clans.py::test_failed_clan_incident_by_status_collapsed_png_snapshot tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_agent_sessions.py::test_failed_session_incident_by_status_expanded_png_snapshot

Result: `counts: created=0 updated=2 unchanged=4 stale=0`; the two `*_120x40` goldens drift. Reproduces identically with `TZ=UTC`, and reproduces with the cause-chip resize changes stashed, so it is independent of that work. The `*_80x40` goldens and both `*_needs_attention_*` panel goldens are unchanged.

task_type_fields.impact: just test-visual drifts on master for these two nodes; the agent rows are pixel-identical (cause chips intact) and only the detail panel differs, so no user-facing defect, but the visual lane cannot go green until the goldens are regenerated.
